'''2003 Florida State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Florida (7 June 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Florida
* '''Dates:''' 7 June 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Venue:''' Sci-Fi City, Orlando, Florida<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' Howard Busch<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Neal Razi]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
